Under phosphine catalysis, TMS-substituted substrate might

substituent, it was difficult to form allenyl anion intermediate.
We further explored this annulation reaction of various
sulfamate-derived cyclic imines 2. As shown in Scheme 3,
various easily synthesized cyclic imines 2b–2n reacted smoothly
with yne-enone 1d, affording the corresponding products 3db–
3dn in high yields with moderate to excellent enantioselectivities
(83–98% yields, 48–91% ee). It is worth noting that the cyclic
imines 2 having substituent at 8-position afforded products in
higher enantioselectivities, compared with those cyclic imines
bearing substituent at 6-position or 5-position (3dd vs 3df, 3dm
vs 3dn). Therefore, we additionally used 1b to react with two
cyclic imines 2c and

having substituent at 8-position, giving
the corresponding product 3bc and 3bg in 89% and 77% yields

determined through single-crystal X-ray diffraction.<sup>[15]</sup>
